'''Johun''', also known as '''Johun the Hunter''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] active during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]]. He was present at the battle for [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], where he was killed in the midst of combat.

==Behind the scenes==
Johun appeared as a boss in the flashpoint Kuat Drive Yards in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]''.
